Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 Thermodynamic control of multiphase evolution in single-crystal Mn-DRX cathodes yields DRX–spinel–monoclinic nanocomposites via oxidative annealing, with composition governing phase selection. This establishes thermodynamically guided multiphase engineering as a strategy overcoming transport and stability limits in disordered rock-salt cathodes.

💡 This review uniquely builds a comprehensive multiscale characterization framework spanning carbon precursors, pyrolysis, particles, microcrystals, pores, and ion transport kinetics.
